bookingUrl.title: Booking address
bookingUrl.description: The web address on your own server that lists free times and takes bookings. The requests it receives are described in the docs.

daysAhead.title: Offer slots up to (days ahead)
daysAhead.description: How many days ahead the AI offers free times.

needsContact.title: A booking needs an email address or a phone number
needsContact.description: The AI asks for one of them (a signed-in visitor's email counts). Your questions and services are in Settings → Tools (Booking questions, Booking services).
